caption:
Hybi's weekly recap for Jan 4 to 9.

Back to training after the break? Start week one at about half your usual volume, then build over 2–3 weeks. At the desk, slow head turns and gentle chin tucks every 30 minutes can help your neck settle back in. Returning to Pilates, it's fine to drop a spring or a few reps for the first couple of weeks. And after a big leg day, an easy 10–15 minute walk or spin is a good way to recover.
